Fit bridge used by the parsnip engine

Source: R/parsnip.R
zuk_parsnip_fit.Rd

This exported bridge is an implementation detail required by parsnip's package-qualified engine registration. Users normally call zuk_reg() and parsnip::fit() rather than invoking it directly.

zuk_parsnip_fit(
  formula,
  data,
  model_id,
  revision = NULL,
  device = NULL,
  reuse = TRUE,
  index,
  id = NULL,
  quantile_levels = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9),
  context_length = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula, data

Passed by parsnip's formula fit interface.

model_id, revision, device, reuse

Checkpoint identity and lifecycle arguments passed to zuk_pretrained().

index, id

Time-index and optional series-id columns.

quantile_levels

Quantiles retained by the fitted engine.

context_length

Optional maximum history used at inference.

...

Load-affecting architecture options forwarded to zuk_pretrained(). They become part of the resident-cache key and are available to the constructor as config$load_options.

Value

A zuk_fit object.

Examples

train <- data.frame(store = "a", day = 1:40,
                    sales = cumsum(rep(2, 40)) + 100)

# Normally reached through zuk_reg() and parsnip::fit(); called directly
# here to show what the engine registration wires up.
fit <- zuk_parsnip_fit(sales ~ ., data = train, model_id = "stub",
                        index = "day", id = "store")
predict(fit, new_data = data.frame(store = "a", day = 41:43))
#>   .pred .pred_lower .pred_upper .pred_q10 .pred_q50 .pred_q90
#> 1   180    179.9998    180.0002  179.9998       180  180.0002
#> 2   180    179.9997    180.0003  179.9997       180  180.0003
#> 3   180    179.9996    180.0004  179.9996       180  180.0004

zuk_unload("stub")
